'God, it hurt us as a country' - outgoing National MP on Treaty compromise

By Political Reporter, RNZ

Outgoing National MP Vanessa Weenink says the compromise the party leader made around Treaty issues hurt the country.

Weenink, who is retiring at this election, told RNZ the decision to support the bill to select committee was made under pressure from coalition partners.

"God, it hurt us as a country," she said. "I don't think we have recovered from that debate yet."

She said the caucus had been divided on the issue, and that several MPs raised concerns privately before the vote.

The Prime Minister's office declined to comment on her remarks, saying the party's position had been clear throughout.
